title: Coverage-Year Accounting Note: The Window over Which Routine Work and Goodwill Drawn Are Counted
content:
When a claim is answered on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, the routine work and the goodwill already drawn on the plan are counted over a window fixed by whether the coverage grants its allowance afresh each year and by what the allowance entries show.

Where the coverage grants its allowance afresh each year and an allowance entry stands on the plan inside the coverage year in progress, the routine work and the goodwill drawn are counted over that coverage year so far. Where the coverage grants its allowance afresh each year and no allowance entry stands on the plan inside the coverage year in progress, they are counted over the 12 months to the handling date. In any other case they are counted over the whole time the plan has been in force.

## Which window is counted over

| The coverage grants its allowance afresh each year | Allowance entries inside the coverage year in progress | The window counted over |
|---|---|---|
| yes | one or more | that coverage year so far |
| yes | none | the 12 months to the handling date |
| no | any | the whole time the plan has been in force |

The coverage year in progress runs from the anniversary of the day coverage began, and its months so far are the whole months since coverage began beyond the coverage years already completed.

## Which plans grant afresh

| Plan | The yearly allowance is granted afresh each year |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | no |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | yes |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | yes |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | yes |

On the Manufacturer Limited Warranty, which does not grant afresh, the third reading is always the one taken.
